title: Aoyagi Toya — Feelings That Were Buried〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line:
Give it up for tonight's headliner!
Vivid BAD SQUAD!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys can keep going, right?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because we're about to blow the roof off this place! Here we go! Try to keep up, alright?!
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad we were able to sing really well...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. I feel like we're singing the parts where we split into pairs and when we're all together much better now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought so too!
It's gotta be because we're all on the same wavelength!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This might've been a case of actually talking about what we were imagining leading to real results in terms of singing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. I definitely think we've taken another step forward as a team.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We have Kohane to thank for absorbing everything Uncle Taiga taught her too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I could help you guys.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Help us... As a team...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I think you're selling yourself too short.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I believe everyone possesses some sort of “unique talent”.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do for us as a team...?)
The next day
Toya's Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Practice today doesn't start until this afternoon. I can work on some things on my own until...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A message...?
From Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Sorry to bother you before practice. There's something I'd like to ask you.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ask me...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Taiga asked me to listen to some classical music to practice seeing different things from a variety of perspectives.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I tried looking up some works by Beethoven and Debussy.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But I was wondering if you had any other suggestions.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Again, I'm sorry.
Initially, I was hesitant about asking you this kind of question...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <But Shinonome said that you wouldn't have a problem with it.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I understand...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what you did is different, Toya. You chose to get back into music again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really gotta love music to do that, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
<I appreciate your concern.
Akito was right to tell you that. I'll send over a list of composers and suitable works.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <I didn't realize there were so many. Thank you so much! Can I show An and Shinonome what you just sent me?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
<Of course.
It may be good for us to all listen to some of them.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Good idea!
I'll post a message to our group chat!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad I could help...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(That's the extent of my knowledge...
Classical music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I know I need to do more if I ever hope to contribute in a more meaningful way...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I...
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to get my head back in the right place before practice...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? Toya?
Practice isn't until much later, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, um... I just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, there is...
Would you mind listening for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A way to make better use of your knowledge and experience with classical music for the sake of your team, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I never had a chance to participate in school events or even play with my friends much for that matter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As a result, I've experienced so much less in life compared to the others...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Classical music is the only area in which I've clearly experienced more than them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's all I really have.
So, I want to make better use of what I know...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, I ran away from classical music...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So I have no right speaking about it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But what do you want to do about that, Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't give me that.
You're doing that thing again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Right and wrong are just words.
Have you asked yourself what you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (What do I want to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Did something flash just now...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, look at that... It's a fragment of a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A fragment of a feeling?
Is that what this ball of light is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. SEKAI are born out of feelings, so similar feelings can sometimes manifest themselves within SEKAI like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just a fragment...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes. It's just that.
Not enough to become a full-fledged SEKAI, so it'll return to being just light in a moment.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(But it flashed just now...
Did that happen because Toya went near it...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A fragment of a feeling, huh?
This place really never ceases to surprise me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's just that sort of place.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Anyway, Toya...
Would you like to take a closer look at this fragment?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, wouldn't that be rude to the owner of this feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it's going to disappear without anyone examining it if you don't.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why I think it'd be good for us to see what happens in place of its owner. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
It would be sad to see it go without anyone actually examining it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Try touching it, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.
